description: This file contains shell functions for evaluating variables, redirecting variable content to files, and checking if variables are set.

methods.name: getvar
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a variable by name passed as argument.

methods.name: var2file
methods.description: Outputs the value of a variable to a specified file if the variable is set.

methods.name: isset
methods.description: Checks if a variable is set and non-empty.
